name: bin-map
title: Cycle-count bin map
description: Warehouse grid of cells by aisle and rack face. Grey cells counted as expected; tinted cells show the direction and magnitude of quantity differences.
needs: A numeric measure. Records represent bins with group [aisle, face] and attrs.slot.

text.lede: Grid of {unit} by aisle and face. A grey cell counted as expected. A tinted cell differs, in the colour of the side that is higher.

text.recount: {key} differs with no pattern around it.

options.name: colourScale
options.description: Percentage difference at which cell colour reaches full intensity.
